text:
Maya: Quick async standup — SDKs / quickstarts / samples
Maya: What I did: finished quickstart for python-sdk (added Windows notes), pushed docs PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/342. Updated sampleapp readme with config examples.
Maya: Blockers: CI flaky on mac wheels for sampleapp (failing binary build step). Logs show a linker error I don't recognize.
Maya: Today: triage CI, ask infra for mac runner access, and get PR ready for review. cc @Ben for review on the quickstart wording.

Ben: Thanks — taking a look at the PR now. Quick note: can we add the minimum pip versions in the install section? I hit issues with older pip in our test matrix.
Ben: Also, do we want a tiny troubleshooting section for the mac wheels? Could save folks time.

Sam: Re: mac wheels — saw that earlier. The failing step is in `pip wheel` stage, error looks like: 
```
error: ld: symbol(s) not found for architecture x86_64
clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
```
Sam: Likely a build flag or missing system lib on the mac runner. I can repro locally if someone can share the exact docker image or runner spec.

Maya: @Sam thanks — I added the runner image name in the PR comment: `macos-runner:2026-02-20` and the failing job id.

Priya: Quick note from docs side: I reviewed the quickstart flow, and the code sample for streaming responses uses the old callback API. Small patch suggestion in the PR to use the new `stream()` helper instead.

Maya: Good catch @Priya — I'll update the snippet. Example replace: 
```
# old
client.generate_stream(prompt)
# new
client.stream(prompt, on_chunk=handle_chunk)
```

Ben: I left inline comments on the PR about pip versions and a wording nit. Will approve after updates.

devex-bot: CI update — docs/pull/342: macos-wheels (failed) • linux-tests (passed) • spellcheck (passed)

Maya: Action items: 1) @Sam try to repro on mac image and post minimal repro steps, 2) @Priya I'll update snippets and add troubleshooting blurb, 3) @Ben update pip version suggestions in docs -> then merge.

Sam: I'll repro today and post a gist with steps. If it's linker flags we can add a note to the sampleapp packaging doc.

Priya: I'll push the snippet edit and add a 2-line troubleshooting note under "Installing on macOS".

Ben: Ping me when changes are in, I'll quick-approve.

Maya: Thanks team — no other blockers from me. If CI is green after fixes, I'll do the follow-up release notes for the quickstart update. :thumbsup:
